prompt: curl variable 64dec invalid base64 decode output
answer:
`64dec` returns a failure marker when the variable does not contain valid Base64. If it contains characters outside the Base64 set, curl unconditionally returns:

```text
64dec-fail
```

The curl man pages show the marker as:

```text
[64dec-fail]
```

Usage:

```bash
curl --variable value=invalid \
     --expand-url 'https://example.com/{{value:64dec}}'
```

`64dec` was added in curl 8.13.0.
